title: AuditTrail event (submission)
description: An event submitted to POST /v1/events. The server seals it into the tenant's hash chain. See schemas/SPEC.md for the canonical hashing rules.

id.description: Client-generated UUID. Doubles as the idempotency key: re-submitting the same id with the same content returns the already-sealed record. Server generates one if omitted.

timestamp.description: When the action happened (RFC 3339). Truncated to millisecond precision and normalized to UTC before hashing. Defaults to server receive time.

human_principal_id.description: The human on whose behalf the action ran. null = fully autonomous or not known.

agent_id.description: The acting agent or service. Use "unknown" rather than omitting.

delegation_chain.description: Ordered ancestry of the action, outermost principal first. Each frame is an object with at least a `type` and an `id`.

previous_hash.description: Optimistic mode only. If present, must equal the tenant's current chain head or the server responds 409.

hash.description: Optimistic mode only. If present, must equal the server's recomputation or the server responds 409.
